title: Intelligence should compound.
subtitle: Build real ventures. Keep what their teams learn. Make the next one more capable.
socialSubtitle: Build ventures. Keep what teams learn. Give the next one a stronger start.
detail: An owner-directed intelligence substrate for independent ventures.
diagramAlt: A measured signal travels from a source venture to another venture. The thesis is that the receiving venture should start more capable; that outcome is not yet measured.
